race.title: Close Brothers Rated Novice Hurdle
race.verdict: IF YOU BELIEVE confirmed previous promise when winning at Galway on return and, with the step up in trip likely to suit, he's fancied to follow up. Marco Du Seuil finally got off the mark at Cork 27 days ago and rates the main danger, while Joe Cool is another open to improvement on the back of 2 promising hurdle runs. IF YOU BELIEVE (IRE) MARCO DU SEUIL (FR) JOE COOL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: If You Believe (15/8), Marco Du Seuil (3/1), Lureka Du Noyer (7/2), El Bilo (8/1), Martymill (8/1), Joe Cool (10/1), Puma's Dream (14/1), Taras Halls (25/1)
